abstract.p: Text-to-SQL oriented table acquisition suffers from heterogeneous semantic gap. To address the issue, we propose a Reverse Engineering (RE) based optimization approach. Instead of forward table search using questions as queries, RE reversely generates potentially-matched question conditioned on table schemas, and promotes semantic consistency verification between homogeneous questions. We experiment on two benchmarks, including SpiderUnion and BirdUnion. The test results show that our approach yields substantial improvements compared to the Retrieval-Reranker (2R) baseline, and achieves competitive performance in both table acquisition and Text-to-SQL tasks. 1
